newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank sets repo tender at unchanged 4.60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank sets repo tender at unchanged 4.60 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set a reverse one-week repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed 4.60 percent.
The operation will run from November 13 to November 20.
This was the third operation to be set at 4.60 percent after the Riksbank announced a new system of setting the repo rate more in the line with the Bundesbank's policy.

Previously the Riksbank had been cutting the repo rate, its key tool for controlling money market liquidity, every second week, trimming the key interest rate from 8.91 percent at the start of the year.
The fixed rate of 4.60 percent was announced three weeks ago and will remain in place for one more operation.
The Riksbank's other key interest rates, its deposit and lending rates, currently stand at 4.25 percent and 5.75 percent respectively.
